 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. The Oklahoma City Thunder will host the Phoenix Suns on Monday. This is the first matchup between the two squads of the 2026-27 regular season.
 The Thunder (3-0) are on the second night of a home back-to-back. They beat the LA Clippers in a 108-101 win on Sunday, but it came at a costly price. Jalen Williams sustained a gruesome-looking leg injury. He needed to be stretchered out. In the game, Shai Gilgeous-Alexander had 34 points and six rebounds.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Meanwhile, the Suns (1-1) had a 131-122 win over the Golden State Warriors on Saturday. Devin Booker went off for 43 points and seven assists. Jalen Green helped with 12 points.
 For live updates of the Thunder's game against the Suns, please regularly check back to this post:
 What channel is Suns vs. Thunder game on today? Time, TV schedule
 TV Channel: Thunder+, KSBI
 Start time: 7 p.m. CT
 Where to watch Suns vs. Thunder on livestream
 Watch Suns vs. Thunder live on Thunder+ 
 Suns vs. Thunder injury updates
 Thunder: Jalen Williams (leg injury) is out. Chet Holmgren (patellar tendinitis) is out. Cason Wallace (shoulder soreness) is out. Nikola Topic (back surgery) is out. Thomas Sorber (knee surgery) is out.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Suns: Oso Ighodaro (oblique strain) is doubtful. Mark Williams (shoulder surgery) is out. Drew Timme (G League two-way) is out.
 Thunder 2026-27 schedule
 Wednesday, Oct. 28: at Mavericks
 Saturday, Oct. 31: at Rockets
 Monday, Nov. 2: at Cavaliers
